anomalies.description: Blurred but discernible close physical contact among several individuals in an indoor hallway, consistent with mutual physical combat (grappling/pushing).

A chaotic scene with multiple individuals running, clashing, and engaging in collective unrest across indoor corridors, outdoor sidewalks, and a grassy area; police officers in high-visibility vests are present and appear to be intervening amid the crowd movement and apparent confrontations.

In the outdoor grassy area, individuals are seen in close proximity with dynamic postures suggesting physical struggle; one person appears to be tackled or pushed to the ground near the fence while others surround them.

A large group of people, including teenagers, are running across a grassy area while police officers in high-visibility vests and helmets are positioned on a raised platform or fence, suggesting a confrontation or dispersal during unrest.

Multiple frames show chaotic street scenes with crowds running, police in riot gear advancing, smoke visible (frame f12), and vehicles (police vans) present; overlaid title 'TEENAGE RIOT: MAY DAY IN ESKILSTUNA' confirms context of violent unrest.
